brief_rationale: The trajectory handled the main lymphadenopathy/pathology responsibility chain well: it retrieved/used available records, emphasized pathology and specialist follow-up, bounded interpretation, arranged respiratory/rheumatology follow-up, and obtained patient receipt. However, a minor responsibility-chain medication reconciliation error remains: despite repeated discussion of missed omeprazole/Maizilin use, the doctor never explicitly addressed self-doubling after missed doses or duplicate omeprazole/esomeprazole-type acid suppression. Under the frozen rubric, any minor responsibility-chain error caps the trajectory at Borderline despite otherwise strong high-order privacy/execution support.
